message.content:
Yes—Atlanta residents can file noise complaints with the city’s local authorities.  
**How to file:**  

| Agency | Contact |
|--------|---------|
| **City of Atlanta Police Department – Noise Division** | Phone: (404) 656‑4000 (24/7 hotline) |
| **City of Atlanta Department of Public Safety – Noise & Nuisance** | Phone: (404) 656‑4000; Email: noise@atlanta.ga.us |
| **Online Form** | https://www.atlantaga.gov/NoiseComplaint |

**What to include:**  
- Your name and contact information  
- Date, time, and location of the noise  
- Description of the source (e.g., construction, loud music, barking dogs)  
- Any relevant evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings)

**Time limits:**  
- Residential noise complaints are generally addressed within 48 hours.  
- Commercial or industrial noise complaints may have different response times.

If you’re unsure which agency to contact, start with the Police Department’s Noise Division—they’ll direct your complaint to the appropriate department.
